svg.title: Most talked about is not most tested
svg.desc: For nine peptides, English posts on X from October 14 to 19, 2026 compared with randomized controlled trials in people on PubMed and FDA approval. BPC-157: 1,205 posts, 0 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no; Retatrutide: 1,098 posts, 10 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no (in trials); Semaglutide: 1,024 posts, 311 randomized trial records, FDA-approved yes, 2017; Tirzepatide: 898 posts, 134 randomized trial records, FDA-approved yes, 2022; GHK-Cu: 717 posts, 1 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no; TB-500: 526 posts, 0 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no; MOTS-c: 409 posts, 0 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no; Epitalon: 258 posts, 0 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no; KPV: 212 posts, 0 randomized trial records, FDA-approved no. Semaglutide and tirzepatide counts are PubMed's randomized-controlled-trial tag; smaller counts were checked by hand.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
